items.source:
This class is used to log the versions of Spring Data Elasticsearch, the Elasticsearch client libs used to built, the
Elasticsearch client libs currently used and of the Elasticsearch cluster. If differences greater than a patchlevel
are detected, these are logged as warnings.
items.translation: 该类用于记录 Spring Data Elasticsearch 的版本、构建时使用的 Elasticsearch 客户端库版本、当前正在使用的 Elasticsearch 客户端库版本以及 Elasticsearch 集群的版本。如果检测到差异大于补丁级别，则将这些差异记录为警告信息。

items.source:
a String to use in a header, containing the versions of Spring Data Elasticsearch and the Elasticsearch
        library
items.translation: 一个用于 Header 的字符串，包含 Spring Data Elasticsearch 和 Elasticsearch 库的版本信息。
